p: Station Parade is right on the doorstep of Newquay's town centre, with shops, cafés and bars a couple of minutes away and the sea not much further. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, so it's for over 18s only; families with kids will want to stick to the town's other attractions.

And Newquay has plenty of those. Great Western and Towan beaches are both a short walk from the station, with the harbour beyond. Fistral, round on the other side of the headland, is one of the UK's best-known surf beaches, with surf schools and board hire for beginners. Newquay Zoo and Trenance Gardens, with its boating lake, make a good family afternoon when the weather turns. Evenings bring a busy bar and restaurant scene in the town centre.
